prime_regimes_unresolved: all sufficiently large primes, unrestricted degree
accepted_claims: Theorem A: for reduced degrees at most three over F_p and p>=11, one nonzero-frequency magnitude equality is equivalent to equality at every nonzero frequency. The five classes are constant/constant, nonconstant linear/linear, quadratic/quadratic, affine-input-equivalent cubics up to output translation, and linear/translated pure cubic precisely when p=2 mod 3.

For depressed cubics AX^3+BX and CX^3+DX, nonzero B,D require B^3/A=D^3/C; B=D=0 requires C/A a cube; exactly one zero is impossible. The negative-sign fiber alternative and zero-sum permutation cases are retained and resolved.

Theorem B: for rational degrees at most three, equality at every sufficiently large prime permits exactly the first four degree classes, with rational u,v,w in g=f(uX+v)+w. Pure-cubic descent uses Chebotarev; finitely many denominator and degree-loss primes are excluded.

Example C: X^2 and X^6 have identical sums for arbitrarily large primes p=2 mod 3 but are not affine-equivalent even over C; equality fails at primes p=1 mod 6 and does not persist at all sufficiently large primes.

Example D: X^4 and -4X^4 have equal magnitudes at every odd prime but no rational input affine equivalence with output sign restricted to +/-1. They are affine-equivalent over C; arbitrary output scaling is not contradicted.

Example E: at p=5, X^3+2X and X^3+3X have complementary fibers and equal magnitudes without affine input equivalence. It is a small-prime boundary example, not an unrestricted-target obstruction or a claim that p>=11 is sharp.
not_claimed: The arbitrary-degree target is OPEN in both prime regimes; no complete classification of decompositions, nongeneric critical values or arithmetic twists.
One-prime or infinitely-many-primes equality does not imply the all-sufficiently-large-primes rational conclusion.
No lower prime bound or sharpness of p>=11; primes 2,3,5,7 are outside Theorem A.
The source-level tension between simple roots and output translation is not resolved and is not a proof dependency.
No new proof of Chebotarev or of prior Sidon-Morse/monodromy or equicritical-quartic theorems; p^2 results do not settle the prime-modulus target.
No historical novelty, priority, exhaustive literature clearance, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification.

scope_fields.exact_gap: General algebraic classification of integral-polynomial pairs with identical difference-value distributions, in both prime regimes.
